referenceSources.description:
A silver 1991 Nissan 200SX S13 coupe is parked on a quiet rural road, framed by a freshly plowed field and an overcast sky. The lowered stance and bronze Rota Torque 17×8.5" wheels with Firestone 245/40‑17 tires hint at its performance upgrades.

Under the hood, the CA18DET 1.8L turbocharged engine has been enhanced with a Garrett GT2560R turbo, front‑mounted intercooler, and a 3" Apex exhaust system, raising power from the stock 169 hp to over 240 hp. Subtle exterior tweaks like the removed rear spoiler and painted valve covers complement the original interior, which features a Momo Race 3000 steering wheel and a high‑power audio setup.
